updates.title: Big Energy 80's
updates.body:
Shoulder pads optional. Sweat mandatory. Still Got It Collective is throwing it back to the decade that invented the dance floor as we know it. Think synth-heavy bangers, neon everything, and zero shame about how hard you're going.

Dance like you did. Sleep like you should.

If you know, you know. And if you've been in the room with us, you're part of this. Our first merch drop is for the community that built this energy from the ground up. Rep the collective. Shirts, hoodies, hats, stickers—yours now.
updates.title: New Merch Drop

updates.body: Tired of staring at the same four walls? Break out. Still Got It Collective is serving up the antidote to your February funk: signature dance vibes, curated whiskey flights, and a packed room ready to move. Winter ends when you say it does.
updates.title: Cure your cabin fever

updates.body: Follow us on Instagram for the stuff that doesn't make it to the flyer—setups, sound checks, and the chaos that makes it all work.
